video_title: The Buss Family Heads to Court - ESPN's Ramona Shelburne on Jeanie vs Siblings on Mason & Ireland

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Ramona Shelburne details the legal allegations against Jeanie, Janie, and Joey Buss
quotes.excerpt: her contention is that Janie Buss and Joey Buss are breaching their fiduciary duty
quotes.quote: A lot of it is similar to what was said in the letter last week. It is putting something into a lawsuit that was written in a letter from a lawyer last week. Her contention is that Janie Buss and Joey Buss, who are the co-trustees of the family trust along with her, are breaching their fiduciary duty, are illegally voting to sell the team, that they don't even have the right to do this because they are bound by the spirit of the trust, which ensures that she should always be voted as the controlling owner as long as she wants to be the controlling owner.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Ed Roski and Patrick Soon-Shiong do not intend to sell Lakers shares
quotes.excerpt: Ed Roski and Patrick Soon-Shiong, who are still minority owners in the Lakers, also have decided not to sell
quotes.quote: Ed Roski and Patrick Soon-Shiong, who are still minority owners in the Lakers, also have decided not to sell any of their shares and that they still want Jeanie Buss to remain as the controlling owner.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Ramona Shelburne clarifies the nature of the reported emergency meeting
quotes.excerpt: it was actually Jim McCormick's way of addressing some of the issues that had been raised by Jim Buss
quotes.quote: This emergency meeting that has been reported on, that was supposedly called by the Lakers' lawyer Jim McCormick, was essentially a way of addressing some of the issues that had been raised by Jim Buss. It wasn't Genie having a 48-hour heads up on Mark Walter selling the team and then trying to change the rules of the trust or dissolve the trust because Mark was selling, which is the way it appeared to the siblings when it first happened.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: The sale to Guggenheim Partners can proceed despite unresolved minority ownership issues
quotes.excerpt: that can go forward because the sale agreement between Guggenheim Partners and Mark Walter has not even been presented

text_blocks.speaker: John Ireland
text_blocks.text: Could the sale to Guggenheim Partners be approved even if the minority ownership situation is unresolved?

text_blocks.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
text_blocks.text: Yes, that can go forward because the sale agreement between Guggenheim Partners and Mark Walter has not even been presented. Walter hasn't essentially sent notice that this deal is done or that they are in agreement. They are enacting tag-along rights to a sale that's only been reported on. It hasn't actually gone through any kind of real agreement phase yet.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss's primary goal is maintaining her status as controlling owner
quotes.excerpt: the only matter is really whether Jeanie can stay on as controlling owner
quotes.quote: The only matter is really whether Jeanie can stay on as controlling owner, because her deal there was with Mark Walter. It was written in paperwork. It wasn't just a handshake agreement. I don't know what happens to that paperwork or how it was written and whether that will stand up to this sale.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Ramona Shelburne predicts the team sale will be completed this year
quotes.excerpt: I think the sale goes through this season. I think it happens probably by the end of this year.
quotes.quote: I think the sale goes through this season. I think it happens probably by the end of this year.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss could potentially buy out her siblings to resolve the dispute
quotes.excerpt: the fastest way for this to go away is for Jeanie to buy out her siblings
quotes.quote: One NBA owner said to me, the fastest way for this to go away is for Jeanie to buy out her siblings. Okay, you want to tag along to the 12.5, I'll give you the same cash, but we're going to change the trust so this never happens again.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: The Dodgers ownership group denies they are selling the team
quotes.excerpt: they say very firmly, in a statement they came out with yesterday, they are not selling the Dodgers.
quotes.quote: Mark Walter and the Dodgers ownership group are pushing back hard against allegations that there were financial problems, financial irregularities, and alleged fraud. They say very firmly, in a statement they came out with yesterday, they are not selling the Dodgers.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Walter is more emotionally attached to the Dodgers than the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I think Mark Walter is much more emotionally attached to the Dodgers than he was the Lakers
quotes.quote: Having reported very closely on this story for two weeks, I think Mark Walter is much more emotionally attached to the Dodgers than he was the Lakers, and with good reason. He has owned the Dodgers for 12 years, they've won three World Series, and he has played a very large role in building the Dodgers.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA is investigating the Clippers' potential salary cap circumvention
quotes.excerpt: they are having conversations with Ballmer and his lawyers already
quotes.quote: They are having conversations with Ballmer and his lawyers already. They are talking about some kind of settlement or some kind of negotiation, but that's already happening. The conversations have been more about this failure to supervise and the nature of the introductions that were made between the Clippers and Kawhi Leonard's people, rather than direct evidence of salary cap circumvention done by Steve Ballmer.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard would remain with the Clippers if the trade to Toronto fails
quotes.excerpt: if this trade doesn't go through, Clippers are fine with Kawhi being back on their team
quotes.quote: If this trade doesn't go through, if for some reason Toronto doesn't want to proceed with it until they know the investigation, Clippers are fine with Kawhi being back on their team.
